description.fun: Entei stands for the fire that burned Johto's Brass Tower. Legend says a new Entei is born each time a volcano appears, and that whenever it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere in the world. It races across the land because it can't contain its own power, and it even leaks flames in its sleep. Its name nods to Yandi, the Flame Emperor of Chinese legend.
description.guide: A Fire-type Legendary Pokémon, one of Johto's three legendary beasts revived by Ho-Oh after the Brass Tower fire; it represents the fire itself. It resembles a lion with a smoky, volcano-like mane. It does not evolve; the Paradox Pokémon Gouging Fire is said to be an ancient relative.
description.tagline: A volcanic lion king whose roar makes volcanoes erupt
